imputation_policy: Only internal NaN values in matrix-only products are interpolated in log10(E). Original experimental-derived data are never overwritten. Separate imputation masks identify every interpolated value.
qc_policy: Primary physics-ready data require finite values, 1 meV <= E <= 1 keV, 0 < T <= 1, and Sigma_R >= 0. Excluded measurements remain preserved in the flagged source table and QC quarantine table.

recommended_use.entropy_fractal_spectral: strict matrices where NaN is supported; otherwise complete matrices together with imputation masks
